description:
A Love-in-Love That Begins Only After Divorce...

With My Ex-Husband!

A new branch director has just been appointed. And guess what? That director... is my ex-husband!

There was a company dinner that night, but when I opened my eyes… I was in a bed.

And the man lying next to me? 

My ex-husband.

I barely managed to scramble out without even dressing properly… But then he called me into his office—no, my ex-husband called me in.

“Did you forget something?”

“Wh-what…?”

What he handed me… was a gift box.

Inside? A whole set of sexy lingerie.

“From now on, wear things like this.”
